title: 第7章 姜月白误上贼船第8章 奇客栈神仙留步
slug: 我在大虞当杀手那些年
content_zh:
少女娇叱，“你顶疼我了！”
裴礼收回顶在少女后腰的竹竿，默默后撤。
这一次，少女并未继续拦路。
裴礼乐得如此，习惯性的用竹竿探路，往竹屋走去。
只是，他很快就发现，那少女与异兽竟是远远地跟着。
裴礼懒得多言，反正竹屋有师父在，没什么好担心的。
远处，
一棵竹子后面，一大一小两颗脑袋长了出来。
少女抬头看了眼异兽，询问道：“老墨，他这像是瞎子吗？”
异兽大大的脑袋低下，“吼。”
“咱们真是英雄所见略同，我也觉得不像。“
“吼。”
“跟上去看看？行啊，你动静小点，别被他发现了。”
“吼。”
“我污蔑你？上次要不是你踩塌了酒楼，我们能被抓住洗了三个月的盘子吗？”
“吼。”
“呀，你还敢怪我带错路！”
少女气得不行，将异兽脖子下的鬃毛拔下一根，疼的异兽龇牙咧嘴。
裴礼听着身后追逐打闹的动静越来越大，无奈的摇摇头。
“阿礼，这两位是你朋友？”

竹屋前，李琛拿着竹扇子，坐在竹椅上纳凉，眼皮都没抬。
“弟子不认识。”裴礼如实道。
“既然不认识，为何要跟着你？”
“这……”
裴礼语塞。
“嗯？老墨，咱们是不是被发现了？”
“吼。”
“什么不关你的事，肯定是你叫的声音太大！”
远处的竹林中，少女再度与异兽吵了起来。
“既然来了，又何必再躲躲藏藏。”
李琛睁开眼，看竹林深处看去。
很快，一人一兽便是走了出来。
“墨玉麒麟！”
师父认出了异兽，而且声音中带着惊讶。
裴礼有些不明所以，不知道这意味着什么。
content_en:
The girl scolded, "You hurt me so much!"
Pei Li took back the bamboo pole that was pressed against the girl's lower back and retreated silently.
This time, the girl did not continue to block the road.
Pei Li was so happy that he habitually used a bamboo pole to find the way to the bamboo house.
However, he soon discovered that the girl and the strange beast were following him from a distance.
Pei Li was too lazy to say anything. Anyway, the master was in the bamboo house, so there was nothing to worry about.
far away,
Behind a bamboo tree, two heads, one big and one small, grew out.
The girl looked up at the strange beast and asked, "Old Mo, does he look like a blind man?"
The alien beast lowered its big head, "Roar."
"We heroes really think alike, and I don't think so either."
"Roar."
"Follow us and take a look? Okay, please be quiet and don't get discovered by him."
"Roar."
"I slandered you? If you hadn't collapsed the restaurant last time, would we have been caught washing dishes for three months?"
"Roar."
"Ah, how dare you blame me for leading you the wrong way!"
The girl was so angry that she plucked out one of the manes under the beast's neck. The beast grinned in pain.
Pei Li listened to the commotion of the chasing and fighting behind him getting louder and louder, and shook his head helplessly.
"Ali, are these two your friends?"
In front of the bamboo house, Li Chen held a bamboo fan and sat on a bamboo chair to enjoy the cool air without raising his eyelids.
"Disciple doesn't know him," Pei Li said matter-of-factly.
"Since I don't know you, why should I follow you?"
"This..."
Pei Li was speechless.
"Huh? Lao Mo, have we been discovered?"
"Roar."
"It's none of your business, you must have screamed too loudly!"
In the distant bamboo forest, the girl quarreled with the strange beast again.
"Now that we're here, why bother hiding anymore."
Li Chen opened his eyes and looked deep into the bamboo forest.
Soon, a man and a beast came out.
"Black jade unicorn!"
The master recognized the strange beast, and there was surprise in his voice.
Pei Li was a little confused and didn't know what this meant.
